result.summary: The screen is generally well structured, but horizontal content is visibly clipped at the right edge and the lower restaurant card is cut off by the viewport/bottom navigation.

issues.description: The horizontal category list is cut off on the right: a partial category pill is visible after “Healthy,” with no clear spacing or affordance indicating the list can be scrolled.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent end padding and either fully hide overflow or add a deliberate horizontal-scroll cue such as a fade/partial next item with adequate spacing.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” horizontal restaurant carousel is clipped at the right edge. The third card and its restaurant name (“Trattoria Piccol…”) are truncated, making the content appear broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side carousel padding and an intentional scroll affordance, or resize cards so the visible items fit cleanly within the viewport.

issues.description: The next card in “Popular right now” is largely obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, leaving only its image visible and making the feed look abruptly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content inset/padding so cards can scroll completely above the bottom navigation.
